Until cycle 136 the 'path ahead' lived only in pasted prompts and chat decisions — a fact tools had to infer from prose, which the loop's own rule (cycle 129) says must be written down as a field instead. CURATED by design: block/steps record owner direction + the on-record ▶ curation; prereqs record only lineage the ledger actually states (do not invent edges to make the tree look fuller). The tech-tree STATES themselves are NOT here — they derive live from RESEARCH_BACKLOG.md's state column, so this file cannot contradict the backlog.

rootsCutoff.note: OWNER 2026-07-27: tech completed at/before this date is the tree's ROOTS — real, but not displayed and not worth pigeonholing. Rows whose state flips to done with a later last_update GROW the tree visibly. Strictly-after comparison, so everything done as of the tree's creation is a root.
